Thanks for the FYI. Reviewed the attached diff doc and the MAP. Quick notes from legal that will affect sequencing:

- Data residency: we can offer US-only or EU+US options. EU-only requires additional SCCs/DPAs and will add ~7 business days. Recommend defaulting to US-only for faster close unless Gaia requires EU.
- Retention buckets: standard is 90 days for logs, 365 days for backups. If Gaia requests 180 days we can accommodate but need to document the tradeoffs in the MAP.
- Indemnity/cap caps: their procurement template reduces our cap to 1x ARR — we should hold to the enterprise standard (10M or 1x ARR, whichever is lower). If they push below 5M we need exec approval.
- Fallback: we can accept a conditional order form that references the DPA (DocuSign envelope to include DPA fields). That will allow procurement to issue PO and pay on receipt of order form, with payment conditioned on DPA execution within 30 days.

Action items:
1) Soojin: confirm whether Gaia will accept US-only residency if that shortens timeline.
